usedFor: Zoho CRM holds new accounts and leads, and PostSpread writes a post once and publishes it to many social accounts. A “New Account” in Zoho CRM can run “Create Post” in PostSpread to queue a post.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Create Post” in PostSpread
bestTemplate.why: “Create Post” can save a draft, so a new account queues a post for review instead of publishing it. “New Lead” is a weaker fit, since a lead is not a customer yet.

watchOut: Choose draft over publish now, or a customer's name goes out unchecked. A post to public accounts waits in Needs you for approval. Both Zoho CRM triggers are polling.
